title: 2023 Panini Prizm Draft Picks Fearless Green Prizm #F-12 Illinois Fighting
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prizm Draft Picks Fearless Green Prizm #F-12 trading card features Devon Witherspoon of the Illinois Fighting Illini football team. The card is an excellent addition to any sports trading card collection and is part of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) league. It is a rookie card and also includes features such as a parallel/variety, which makes it a unique and valuable card. 

The card is manufactured by Panini and is part of the 2023 season set. It is an insert card from the Fearless insert set and does not include an autograph. With its stunning green prizm design, this card is perfect for any football fan who wants to add a unique and valuable card to their collection.
